announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l7 — Priority and refresh updates
announcements.summary: Multi-device sharing, account priorities, and persistent login across reloads.
announcements.content:
This stable local build includes the l6 sharing updates and the l7 account and startup improvements.
1. Share one primary account with multiple followers, report cached usage asynchronously, and remove follower credentials when an account is returned.
2. Dashboard, quota scheduling, and Gateway fallback honor the same account priority order.
3. Quota exhaustion is tracked separately from authentication health, and renewal sync displays device notes.
4. Reload restores the current account and preserves login for access-only follower credentials.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l7 — 优先级与刷新改进
zh.summary: 多设备共享、账号优先顺序，以及 reload 后账号与登录态恢复。
zh.content:
本稳定本地版本包含 l6 的共享扩展与 l7 的账号、启动改进。
1. 同一主设备账号可同步给多个从设备，用量缓存异步汇报，归还时自动删除从设备凭证。
2. Dashboard、额度调度和 Gateway fallback 使用一致的账号优先顺序。
3. 额度耗尽与认证健康状态分开处理，续期同步显示设备备注名。
4. reload 后恢复当前账号，并保留无续期凭据从设备的登录态。
